description_en: Modifies the disk type of an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 修改云数据库 MongoDB 版的磁盘类型
name: ModifyDBInstanceDiskType

parameters.help_en:
The new disk type. Valid values:
cloud_auto: ESSD AutoPL cloud disk.

Prerequisite: The disk space of the instance must be at least 40 GB before you call this operation. If the disk space is insufficient, call ModifyDBInstanceSpec to expand the disk
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的磁盘类型，取值：
cloud_auto：ESSD AutoPL 云盘。

前置条件：调用前实例磁盘空间须不小于 40GB；不足时请先调用 ModifyDBInstanceSpec 扩容磁盘
parameters.name: db_instance_storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The provisioned performance (IOPS). Valid values: 0 to 50,000.

If DbInstanceStorageType is set to cloud_auto, this parameter is conditionally required and can be set to 0. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns InvalidParameter
parameters.help_zh:
预配置性能（IOPS）。取值范围为 0~50000。

当 DbInstanceStorageType 设为 cloud_auto 时，本参数为条件必填，可传入 0；未提供时 API 返回 InvalidParameter
parameters.name: provisioned_iops

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:
true: enables automatic payment. Make sure that your account has sufficient balance.
<props="china">- false: disables automatic payment. You can manually pay for the order in the console. Log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console. In the upper-right corner of the page, choose Expenses > Expenses and Costs. In the left-side navigation pane, choose Orders > My Orders. On the Orders tab, find the target order and complete the payment.</props>
<props="intl">- false: disables automatic payment. You can manually pay for the order in the console. Log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console. In the upper-right corner of the page, choose Expenses > Expenses and Costs. In the left-side navigation pane, click Order Management. On the Orders page, find the target order and complete the payment.</props>

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费。取值：
true：自动付费，请确保账号有足够的余额。
<props="china">- false：控制台手动付费。您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在页面右上角选择费用 > 费用与成本，在左侧导航栏，选择订购订单>我的订单，在商品订单页签找到目标订单进行支付。</props>
<props="intl">- false：控制台手动付费。您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在页面右上角选择费用 > 费用与成本，在左侧导航栏，单击订单管理，在商品订单页面找到目标订单进行支付。</props>

默认值为：true
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The additional parameter for business information
parameters.name: business_info

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:
true: enables auto-renewal.
false: disables auto-renewal.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费，取值说明：
true：开启自动续费。
false：不开启自动续费。

默认值为 false
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The specification change type. Valid values:

UPGRADE: upgrades the configurations.
DOWNGRADE: downgrades the configurations.

This parameter is available only when the billing method of the instance is subscription
parameters.help_zh:
变配类型，取值：

UPGRADE：升级配置。
DOWNGRADE：降级配置。

当实例付费方式为包年包月时，该参数可用
parameters.name: order_type
